role: An AbstractTexture that layers several textures on top of each other with ImageIO/BufferedImage and uploads the result as one GL texture.
notes: Not reached by any in-game path the native engine mirrors; the native renderer loads textures as pre-converted RGBA dumps from csrc/assets instead of through the GL texture-object system. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: GL texture plumbing that composites layers with ImageIO; used only for the horse armour layers (horses = off) and never on a path the native renderer mirrors.
